GROUP BY l_returnflag, l_linestatus
ORDER BY l_returnflag, l_linestatus

WITH german_supplier_stock AS (

    ps_partkey,

  FROM german_supplier_stock

part_values AS (

  GROUP BY ps_partkey
)
SELECT

SELECT
    s.s_suppkey,
    s.s_name,
    s.s_address,
    s.s_phone,
    SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue
FROM
    supplier s
JOIN
    lineitem l ON s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
WHERE
    l.l_shipdate >= '1996-01-01'
    AND l.l_shipdate < '1996-04-01'
GROUP BY
    s.s_suppkey,
    s.s_name,
    s.s_address,
    s.s_phone
ORDER BY
    total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 1

5. Join region with nation on n_regionkey = r_regionkey

SELECT s.s_name, s.s_address
FROM supplier s
JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey
JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey
JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey AND ps.ps_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
WHERE n.n_name = 'CANADA'
  AND p.p_name LIKE 'forest%'
GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_address, ps.ps_partkey
HAVING 
  (SELECT SUM(l2.l_quantity) FROM lineitem l2 
   WHERE l2.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey 
   AND l2.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey 
   AND l2.l_shipdate >= '1994-01-01'

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.p_type LIKE 'PROMO%' THEN l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount) ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS promo_revenue
